channel.title: The AI Workshop
channel.description: An offline space for non-techies to put AI to work, one real use-case project at a time.

item.title: Build Your First AI Automation: Leads, Emails and a Bot
item.description: Walk in with the questions your customers keep asking. Walk out at 4:00 PM with an automation running for your business: every new enquiry gets a personal AI-written reply within minutes, three follow-up emails that stop once the lead replies, and a Telegram bot that answers from your own price list. Four hours, offline, no coding. Sunday, 25 October 2026, 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM. Salt Lake, Kolkata. 50 seats. ₹699.
